about.title: Pioneering the Future of Indian Sports
about.description: The ITF OF INDIA (Trust) is a premier national organization committed to the development and promotion of diverse athletic disciplines across the country.
about.desc1: is a national-level sports trust committed to the development of athletics across India. We bridge the gap between local potential and professional success.
about.desc2: Founded on the principles of discipline and perseverance, we provide specialized training in Karate, Kabaddi, and over 20 other sports to build the champions of tomorrow.
about.vision_text: To become the premier national hub for athletic excellence, where every aspiring sportsperson in India has the platform, resources, and guidance to compete at the Olympic level.
about.mission_text: We are dedicated to identifying grassroots talent, providing world-class infrastructure, and fostering a culture of discipline, integrity, and social inclusion through multi-sport programs.
about.pillar1_desc: Empowering marginalized communities through accessible sports infrastructure.
about.pillar2_desc: Elite coaching and pathways for international competition success.
about.pillar3_desc: Committed to the highest standards of sports administration and ethics.
